definition_en: to have a plan or purpose in mind, or to be meant for a particular use
core_image: 弓弦被拉紧，箭尖指向远处的一点，手还没松开
scene: 院子里搭了一半的木架，工具摆在地上，主人正看着图纸。We intend to finish the fence before the first frost.
sceneCN: 这里 intend 是「打算」（第 1 个义项：心里已有计划），句意为我们打算在第一场霜前把篱笆修完。画面里的物件：半成品木架、工具、图纸。

pos.zh: 动词：打算；意图；意为

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ion 构成，义为「意图；打算」
由同一词干构成，义为「意图」；也作形容词「专注的」
由过去分词转作形容词，义为「预期的；预定的」
由否定前缀 un- 加过去分词构成，义为「非故意的」

senses.title: Plan to do something
senses.definition: to have something in mind as a plan or purpose
senses.definitionCN: 把某事件作为计划或目的放在心上
senses.example: They intend to move the shop closer to the station.
senses.exampleCN: 他们打算把店搬到离车站更近的地方。
senses.why: Latin intendere means to stretch towards, like a bow aimed at a mark.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 intendere 意为「朝……伸展」，像弓瞄准靶子。

senses.title: Mean something by words
senses.definition: to mean a particular thing by what one says or does
senses.definitionCN: 指通过言语或行为想表达某个特定的意思
senses.example: I intended a warning, not a joke.
senses.exampleCN: 我想表达的是警告，不是玩笑。
senses.why: Mind is a kind of aim: words are arrows shot at a hearer's understanding.
senses.whyCN: 心意也是一种瞄准：话是射向听者理解的箭。

senses.title: Be meant for a use
senses.definition: to be planned or designed for a particular person or purpose
senses.definitionCN: 为某个人或某种目的而规划或设计
senses.example: The small room was intended for the children.
senses.exampleCN: 这个小房间是为孩子们准备的。
senses.why: The passive form focuses on the target of the aim rather than on the planner.
senses.whyCN: 被动形式把注意力从计划者移到被瞄准的用途上。

intro.en: Intend comes from Latin intendere "to stretch towards", the same verb that gives tension and attention.
intro.cn: intend 来自拉丁语 intendere「朝……伸展」，与 tension、attention 同一动词。

items.en: Tendere "to stretch" joined in- "towards" to make intendere.
items.cn: tendere「伸展」与 in-「朝向」合成 intendere。

items.en: Archers used intendere arcum, to bend a bow, always aiming at something.
items.cn: 弓箭手用 intendere arcum 表示「弯弓」，总是指向某物。

items.en: The noun intentio named the act of aiming the mind.
items.cn: 名词 intentio 指让心瞄准的动作。

items.en: French entendre "to mean, to understand" carried the word into English.
items.cn: 法语 entendre（意为、听懂）把这个词带入英语。

items.en: English fixed the spelling intend and the contrast with intend versus attend.
items.cn: 英语固定了拼写 intend，并与 attend 形成对照。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the tendere root of stretching; the near-meaning group holds other words for planning.
note.cn: 形近组共享表示「伸展」的词根 tendere；近义组收其他表示计划的词。

entries.definition: The noun for purpose; the adjective for being focused.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「意图」，形容词义为「专注的」。

entries.definition: To stretch something out or forward.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「伸展；延长」。

entries.definition: To stretch the mind towards a meeting or a task.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「出席」，原指把心伸向某事。

entries.definition: To arrange the steps of a future action.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「计划」，安排未来行动的步骤。

entries.definition: To have something as one's purpose by nature.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「意欲」，侧重语言本身所指。

entries.definition: To point at a target, literally or figuratively.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「瞄准；旨在」，字面或比喻皆可。

normalIntro.en: The hooks use the stretched bow inside the word and its habitual phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子利用词里那张拉开的弓以及它的习惯搭配。

normal.en: in plus tend: stretch the mind towards a target.
normal.cn: in 加 tend：把心思朝靶子伸过去。

normal.en: We intend to finish early, and as intended we do.
normal.cn: 我们打算早点完成，也如预期完成了。

normal.en: The knife is intended for bread, not for wood.
normal.cn: 这把刀是为切面包准备的，不是砍木头的。

normal.en: Intend has a plan; attention has a focus.
normal.cn: intend 是有计划，attention 是有焦点。

normal.en: He intended no harm, only a quiet warning.
normal.cn: 他并无恶意，只是想轻声警告。

abstract.en: To intend is to draw a bow before saying a word.
abstract.cn: 打算就是在开口前先把弓拉开。

abstract.en: An intention is an arrow released only half way.
abstract.cn: 意图是一支只射出一半的箭。

abstract.en: People judge the deed, while you remember the aim.
abstract.cn: 别人评判行为，你自己记得当初的瞄准。

examples.en: We intend to keep the old sign over the door.
examples.cn: 我们打算把门上那块旧招牌留着。

examples.en: She intended her remark as a warning, not an insult.
examples.cn: 她那句话是想提醒，而不是侮辱。

examples.en: The path was intended for walkers, not bicycles.
examples.cn: 这条小路是为步行者修的，不是给自行车的。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因疼的」——还没动手就先因想着而心疼，那是打算

root: 拉丁语 tendere「伸展」→ in-「朝向」+ tendere → intendere「朝……伸展、瞄准」→ 古法语 entendre → 英语 intend。同族词：intention、intent、extend、attend。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: planning to act, meaning a certain thing, and being designed for a purpose.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：计划去做、话里想要表达，以及为某用途而设定。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a drawn bow aimed at a distant mark.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张拉满的弓指向远处的靶点。

branches.en: THE PLAN: the bow is drawn for tomorrow's task.
branches.cn: 计划这条线：为明天的任务拉开的弓。

branches.en: THE REMARK: words are aimed at a hearer's mind.
branches.cn: 话语这条线：话瞄准听者的头脑。

branches.en: THE SMALL ROOM: a space is aimed at one kind of user.
branches.cn: 小房间这条线：空间瞄准某一类使用者。

branches.en: THE LINK: both are aims inside a mind.
branches.cn: 连接线：两者都是心里的瞄准。

branches.en: THE LINK: what is planned is also what is designed.
branches.cn: 连接线：所打算的也正是所设计的。

intro.en: Intend = in- "towards" + the root tend- "stretch", with no separate English suffix.
intro.cn: intend = in-「朝向」+ 词根 tend-「伸展」，没有单独的英语后缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin tendere, intendere and intentio are all attested.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 tendere、intendere、intentio 均有记载。

items.example: It directs the stretching.
Also in tension and tendon.
items.exampleCN: 也见于 tension 与 tendon。

items.example: The verb alone means to stretch out.
It is the noun behind intention.
items.exampleCN: 它是 intention 背后的名词。

items.example: It forms intention.
It forms the adjective intended.
It forms unintended results.
The prefix ex- points outward.

definition_zh: 强烈的；剧烈的；紧张的；热情的
definition_en: very great or extreme in strength, feeling, or degree
core_image: 灯丝被拧到最亮，光晕几乎要把镜头烧白
scene: 舞台上只剩一束聚光灯，演员额头冒汗，观众连呼吸都放轻了。The heat in the small kitchen was so intense that the windows steamed up.
sceneCN: 这里 intense 是「强烈的、极度的」（第 1 个义项：强度极大），句意小厨房里热得厉害，窗户都起了雾。画面里的物件：聚光灯、额头的汗、起雾的窗。

pos.zh: 形容词：强烈的；剧烈的；紧张的；热情的

derivatives.zh: 由本词换后缀构成，义为「强度；强烈」
由本词加 -ly 构成，义为「强烈地」
由本词加 -ify 构成，义为「加强；加剧」
由同一词干构成，义为「紧张；内涵」

senses.title: Very strong in degree
senses.definition: extremely great in strength, force, or amount
senses.definitionCN: 在力度、力量或数量上极其之大
senses.example: The midday sun was so intense that the paint cracked.
senses.exampleCN: 中午的太阳太烈，油漆都裂开了。
senses.why: Latin intensus is the participle of intendere, "stretched tight".
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 intensus 是 intendere「绷紧」的分词。

senses.title: Deeply felt
senses.definition: felt very strongly, as of feelings, interest, or dislike
senses.definitionCN: 指情感、兴趣或厌恶等感受非常强烈
senses.example: She has an intense love of mountain air.
senses.exampleCN: 她极爱山里的空气。
senses.why: The same tightness is applied to feeling: emotions can be stretched to their limit.
senses.whyCN: 同样的「绷紧」被用到情感上：情绪也会绷到极限。

senses.title: Serious and concentrated
senses.definition: very serious, busy, and demanding of attention
senses.definitionCN: 非常严肃、繁忙，要求全神贯注
senses.example: The weeks before the exam were intense for everyone in the class.
senses.exampleCN: 考前那几周全班人都很紧张。
senses.why: Work and study borrow the word for a stretched state with no slack left.
senses.whyCN: 工作与学习借这个词形容毫无余裕的绷紧状态。

senses.title: Extreme in a worrying way
senses.definition: so extreme as to be frightening or unpleasant
senses.definitionCN: 极端到令人害怕或不快的程度
senses.example: The attack drew intense criticism from the town council.
senses.exampleCN: 那次攻击引来市议会猛烈的批评。
senses.why: Tightness can be unpleasant: stretched too far, strength becomes a threat.
senses.whyCN: 绷得太紧便会不好受：力量过头就成了威胁。

intro.en: Intense is a Latin participle of intendere "to stretch towards", so its core is tightness.
intro.cn: intense 是拉丁语 intendere「朝……伸展」的分词，因此其核心是「绷紧」。

items.en: Tendere "to stretch" with in- "towards" yields intendere, to strain forward.
items.cn: tendere「伸展」与 in-「朝向」构成 intendere「向前绷紧」。

items.en: Intensus described a bow or string pulled tight.
items.cn: intensus 形容被拉得很紧的弓或弦。

items.en: Late Latin extended the participle to light, heat, and emotions that reach a peak.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语把这个分词扩展到达到顶点的光、热与情感。

items.en: French intense narrowed the meaning to things very great in degree.
items.cn: 法语 intense 把意义窄化为「程度极大之事」。

items.en: English uses intense for heat, pressure, feeling, and, loosely, for earnest people.
items.cn: 英语用 intense 形容热、压力、感受，口语中也形容过于认真的人。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the stretched root; the near-meaning group holds other words for great strength.
note.cn: 形近组共享「绷紧」词根；近义组收表示「强度大」的词。

entries.definition: Concentrated on one task, such as a course.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「集中的、强化的」，如强化课程。

entries.definition: The measurable strength of heat, light or feeling.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「强度」，可测量的量。

entries.definition: Purpose, or else fixed and absorbed.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「意图」，形容词义为「专注的」。

entries.definition: Violent and angry, often of animals or weather.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「凶猛的」，多指动物或天气。

entries.definition: Sharp and strong, often of pain or problems.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「剧烈的」，多形容疼痛或问题。

entries.definition: Great in feeling or seriousness rather than force.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，偏指情感或程度之深，而非力量之大。

normalIntro.en: The hooks hang on the image of a string pulled to its limit.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子挂在「绳子拉到极限」这一画面上。

normal.en: Intense is a string with no slack left.
normal.cn: intense 就是一根再没有余量的弦。

normal.en: Intense heat, intense pressure, intense competition: the word adds a peak.
normal.cn: 酷热、巨大压力、激烈竞争：这个词都添上一个「顶点」。

normal.en: Intensity is what intense measures.
normal.cn: intensity 是 intense 所衡量的那个量。

normal.en: Intensive study is short and hard; intense study feels full of pressure.
normal.cn: intensive 学习短而猛，intense 学习则是压得满满。

normal.en: An intense person is rarely bored.
normal.cn: 性格强烈的人很少觉得无聊。

abstract.en: Intensity is a fire you cannot look away from.
abstract.cn: 强度是一团你无法转开视线的火。

abstract.en: Anything stretched too long returns changed.
abstract.cn: 任何拉得过久的东西回来时都变了样。

abstract.en: The word asks not how much, but how tight.
abstract.cn: 这个词不问多少，只问绷得多紧。

examples.en: The pressure before the launch was intense.
examples.cn: 发射前的压力非常大。

examples.en: He felt an intense dislike of crowded rooms.
examples.cn: 他对拥挤的房间有强烈的厌恶。

examples.en: Competition for the scholarship is intense this year.
examples.cn: 今年奖学金的竞争十分激烈。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因太死」——绷得太死太紧，所以强度极高

root: 拉丁语 tendere「伸展」→ in- + tendere → intendere「朝前绷紧」→ 分词 intensus「拉紧的」→ 古法语 intense → 英语 intense。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: extreme degree, deep feeling, tense work, and unpleasant violence.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：程度极高、情感浓烈、工作紧张，以及令人不适的猛烈。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a filament turned to full brightness.
core.cn: 核心意象：灯丝被开到最亮。

branches.en: THE SUN AT NOON: heat and light reach their peak.
branches.cn: 正午太阳这条线：热与光达到顶点。

branches.en: THE LOVED AIR: feeling is stretched to its edge.
branches.cn: 山间空气这条线：情感被拉到边缘。

branches.en: THE EXAM WEEK: attention has no slack left.
branches.cn: 考试周这条线：注意力毫无余裕。

branches.en: THE HARSH ATTACK: strength turns into threat.
branches.cn: 猛烈攻击这条线：力量变为威胁。

branches.en: THE LINK: both describe being pushed near a limit.
branches.cn: 连接线：两者都形容被推到接近极限。

intro.en: Intense = in- "towards" + tens- "stretch" + -e, with the Latin participle ending dropped.
intro.cn: intense = in-「朝向」+ tens-「伸展」+ -e，拉丁分词词尾已脱落。

latinIntro.en: Latin intendere and intensus are recorded; English remodelled the ending.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 intendere 与 intensus 有记载，英语改铸了词尾。

items.example: It gives direction to the stretch.
Also in tension and tensor.
items.exampleCN: 也见于 tension 与 tensor。

items.example: It is the direct ancestor.
It forms intensity.
It forms intensify.
It forms intensely.
It forms intensive.
It appears in intension.

definition_en: a plan or aim that you have in mind, especially before doing something
core_image: 出门前在便签上写下一行小计划，贴在门边
scene: 桌角压着一张便签，上面写着明早要去的地方，还有要带的东西。He had no intention of selling the boat, whatever the price.
sceneCN: 这里 intention 是「打算、意向」（第 1 个义项：心里的计划），句意无论价钱多少，他都无意卖掉那条船。画面里的物件：便签、压纸的茶杯、笔。

pos.zh: 名词：意图；意向；打算

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -al 构成，义为「故意的」
由 intentional 加 -ly 构成，义为「故意地」
由同一词干构成，义为「打算」
由否定前缀加 intentional 构成，义为「非故意的」

senses.title: A plan in mind
senses.definition: something you plan or mean to do, often before any action is taken
senses.definitionCN: 你计划或打算要做的事，常在行动之前就在心里
senses.example: Her intention was to study law, not medicine.
senses.exampleCN: 她的打算是学法律，不是学医。
senses.why: Latin intentio names the stretching of the mind towards a target.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 intentio 指心灵朝目标伸展的动作。

senses.title: The reason behind an act
senses.definition: the purpose that explains why something was done
senses.definitionCN: 解释某事为何被做的那个目的
senses.example: The letter was written with the best of intentions.
senses.exampleCN: 这封信是怀着一片好意写的。
senses.why: Actions are read through intentions: the same deed can be kind or cruel.
senses.whyCN: 行为要透过用意来读：同一个举动可以是善意，也可以是残忍。

senses.title: Meaning in words
senses.definition: the meaning a speaker or writer wants words to carry
senses.definitionCN: 说话或写作的人希望词语承载的意义
senses.example: The intention of the rule is to keep the path clear.
senses.exampleCN: 这条规则的用意是让小路保持通畅。
senses.why: Law and criticism speak of the intention of a text when they argue about meaning.
senses.whyCN: 法律与批评在争论意义时，会谈文本的「意图」。

intro.en: Intention is the Latin noun intentio, "a stretching towards", from intendere.
intro.cn: intention 是拉丁语名词 intentio「朝……伸展」，来自 intendere。

items.en: In- "towards" with tendere "to stretch" gives intendere.
items.cn: in-「朝向」与 tendere「伸展」构成 intendere。

items.en: Intentio named both the physical tension and the aim of the mind.
items.cn: intentio 兼指物理的张力与心灵的瞄准。

items.en: Scholastic writers used intentio for the direction of the will and of meaning.
items.cn: 经院作家用 intentio 指意志的方向与意义所指。

items.en: French entencion brought the word into English writing in the Middle Ages.
items.cn: 中世纪时法语 entencion 把此词带入英语写作。

items.en: English kept the plain sense of a plan and the legal sense of what a rule is for.
items.cn: 英语保留了「打算」的平实义与「规则为何而立」的法律义。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the aiming root; the near-meaning group holds words for plans and purposes.
note.cn: 形近组共享「瞄准」词根；近义组收表示计划与目的的词。

entries.definition: Purpose, often sharper and more legal than intention.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「意图」，常更尖锐、更偏法律。

entries.definition: The verb that carries the plan.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，承载这个计划。

entries.definition: Something newly created, not planned.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「发明」，指新造之物。

entries.definition: A set of steps written out for the future.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「计划」，写明的步骤。

entries.definition: The reason a thing exists or is done.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「目的」，事物存在的理由。

entries.definition: The single point one hopes to hit.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「目标」，希望命中的那一点。

normalIntro.en: The hooks connect the note on the desk with the phrases surrounding intention.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把桌上那张便签与 intention 周边的搭配连起来。

normal.en: An intention is a promise made to yourself first.
normal.cn: 意图是先对自己许下的诺言。

normal.en: I have no intention of arguing about the price.
normal.cn: 我无意在价格上争论。

normal.en: With the intention of helping, he said too much.
normal.cn: 他本意是帮忙，却说多了。

normal.en: Good intentions cannot replace good results.
normal.cn: 好意图代替不了好结果。

normal.en: The intention of the law matters as much as its words.
normal.cn: 法律的用意与它的字句同样重要。

abstract.en: Intention is a seed that may never see daylight.
abstract.cn: 意图是一颗也许见不到光的种子。

abstract.en: Between intention and deed lies the whole person.
abstract.cn: 意图与行为之间，横着整个人。

abstract.en: We judge our own intentions and others' actions.
abstract.cn: 我们看自己的用心，看别人的行为。

examples.en: She had every intention of calling you back.
examples.cn: 她本来很打算给你回电话。

examples.en: The bridge was built with the intention of cutting travel time.
examples.cn: 修这座桥的用意是缩短通行时间。

examples.en: His good intentions did not save the meeting.
examples.cn: 他的好心并没有挽救那次会议。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因她身」——心里因她而打定主意，是意图

root: 拉丁语 tendere「伸展」→ intendere「朝……伸展」→ intentio「伸展、意图」→ 古法语 entencion → 英语 intention。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: a plan in mind, the reason for an act, and the meaning meant by words.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：心里的打算、行为背后的用意，以及话语所指的意思。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small note pinned by the door before leaving.
core.cn: 核心意象：出门前贴在门边的一张小便签。

branches.en: THE NOTE: the plan exists before any action.
branches.cn: 便签这条线：计划先于行动而存在。

branches.en: THE LETTER: a kind act or a cruel one depends on the reason.
branches.cn: 那封信这条线：善举或恶行取决于用意。

branches.en: THE RULE: words carry a purpose beyond their letters.
branches.cn: 规则这条线：字句之外还带着用意。

branches.en: THE LINK: plan and reason are the same aim seen before and after.
branches.cn: 连接线：打算与用意是同一目标的前后两面。

branches.en: THE LINK: acts and texts are both read for intent.
branches.cn: 连接线：行为与文本都要被读出意图。

intro.en: Intention = in- "towards" + tent- "stretch" + -ion "the act of".
intro.cn: intention = in-「朝向」+ tent-「伸展」+ -ion「……的行为」。

latinIntro.en: Latin intendere and intentio are attested; the suffix layers are productive.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 intendere 与 intentio 有记载，各词尾层仍能产。

items.example: It sets the direction of the aim.
The stem reappears in attention.
The verb is the family trunk.
It turns the verb into a plan.
It forms intentional.
It forms unintentional.
It forms intentionally.
A shorter word for the same aim.

definition_zh: 相互作用；交互作用；互动
definition_en: the activity of two or more things or people acting on each other
core_image: 两端各有一只手来回拉同一根绳子，绳子中间打了几个结
scene: 课堂上老师抛出问题，学生接一句，老师再回一句，话在两边来回飞。Daily interaction with neighbours keeps a street safe.
sceneCN: 这里 interaction 是「互动、相互作用」（第 1 个义项：彼此往来的过程），句意与邻居的日常往来让街道更安全。画面里的物件：课桌、举起的手、街角的门阶。

pos.zh: 名词：相互作用；交互作用；互动

derivatives.zh: 由本词去掉 -ion 构成，义为「互动；互相作用」
由本词换后缀构成，义为「互动的」
由 interactive 加 -ly 构成，义为「互动地」
由本词加 -al 构成，义为「与互动有关的」

senses.title: People acting on people
senses.definition: the way people behave towards and respond to one another
senses.definitionCN: 人们彼此相处并相互回应的方式
senses.example: Short interactions at the shop door can make a lonely day lighter.
senses.exampleCN: 店门口几句短短的往来，能让孤单的一天变轻松。
senses.why: It is the noun of action of interact, from Latin inter plus agere.
senses.whyCN: 它是 interact 的行为名词，来自拉丁语 inter 加 agere。

senses.title: Things affecting each other
senses.definition: the combined effect of two or more forces, substances, or systems on each other
senses.definitionCN: 两种或多种力、物质或系统彼此的合成影响
senses.example: The interaction between wind and current shaped the coast.
senses.exampleCN: 风与海流的相互作用塑造了海岸。
senses.why: Science speaks of interactions where a single cause will not explain a result.
senses.whyCN: 在单一原因解释不了结果时，科学就谈相互作用。

senses.title: In scientific research
senses.definition: a measurable effect in which one factor changes how another factor works
senses.definitionCN: 一种可测量的效应：一个因素改变了另一个因素的作用方式
senses.example: The study found an interaction between diet and sleep.
senses.exampleCN: 研究发现饮食与睡眠之间存在交互效应。
senses.why: Statistics needed a word for two things acting together rather than separately.
senses.whyCN: 统计学需要一个词指两个因素一起起作用而不是各自起作用。

senses.title: With machines
senses.definition: the exchange between a user and a device or program
senses.definitionCN: 使用者与装置或程序之间的交换
senses.example: Good design makes interaction with the machine feel natural.
senses.exampleCN: 好的设计让与机器的往来显得自然。
senses.why: Software designers borrowed the social word to describe tapping and typing.
senses.whyCN: 软件设计者借用了这个社交词来描述点按与打字。

intro.en: Interaction combines inter- "between", agere "to do", and the noun ending -ion.
intro.cn: interaction 由 inter-「之间」、agere「做」与名词词尾 -ion 组成。

items.en: Agere "to do, drive" supplied actus and actio.
items.cn: agere「做、驱动」提供了 actus 与 actio。

items.en: Inter as a prefix marked what happens between two parties.
items.cn: inter 作前缀标出发生在两方之间的事。

items.en: Interaction was formed in the eighteenth century for mutual influence.
items.cn: interaction 在十八世纪成形，指相互影响。

items.en: Social science adopted it for the study of persons and groups.
items.cn: 社会科学采用它来研究个人与群体。

items.en: Computing added human-computer interaction, now a field of its own.
items.cn: 计算机领域添上了「人机交互」，如今已是独立学科。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the agere root; the near-meaning group holds other words for exchanges.
note.cn: 形近组共享 agere 词根；近义组收其他表示交流的词。

entries.definition: The verb of acting mutually.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「互动」。

entries.definition: A response to something that happened.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「反应」，对已发生之事的回应。

entries.definition: Doing something, without the mutual element.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「行动」，不含相互之意。

entries.definition: The passing of information or feeling.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「交流」，传达信息或感受。

entries.definition: The mere fact of touching or meeting.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「接触」，只指碰上或会面。

entries.definition: A giving and taking in return.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「交换」，给出去并收回。

normalIntro.en: The hooks hold on to the image of words flying back and forth across a room.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子抓住「话在房间里来回飞」这一画面。

normal.en: Inter- between, act do, -ion the process: doing between.
normal.cn: inter- 在之间，act 做，-ion 过程：在双方之间来回做。

normal.en: Social interaction at the door can save a whole day.
normal.cn: 门口几句交往能救回一整天的心情。

normal.en: Wind and water interaction built the harbour.
normal.cn: 风与水的相互作用造出了这个港口。

normal.en: Human-computer interaction is now taught as its own subject.
normal.cn: 人机交互如今已作为独立学科讲授。

normal.en: Fewer screens means more face-to-face interaction.
normal.cn: 少盯屏幕就多一些面对面往来。

abstract.en: Everything interesting happens between things.
abstract.cn: 一切有趣的事都发生在事物之间。

abstract.en: A conversation is a rope pulled from both ends.
abstract.cn: 一段对话是一根两端都在拉的绳。

abstract.en: Isolation is the absence of a single interaction.
abstract.cn: 孤立就是连一次往来都没有。

examples.en: Regular interaction with teachers helps shy children speak up.
examples.cn: 常与老师往来能让害羞的孩子开口。

examples.en: The interaction of light and shadow gives the painting its depth.
examples.cn: 光与影的相互作用赋予这幅画深度。

examples.en: The app was praised for smooth interaction between pages.
examples.cn: 这款应用因页面之间流畅的交互而受到称赞。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因特爱克神」——网上互相支持得很神，就是互动

root: 拉丁语 inter-「在……之间」+ agere「做、驱动」+ -ion → 英语 interaction。同族：interact、interactive、react、action。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: people with people, things with things, statistical effects, and users with machines.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：人与人的往来、物与物的影响、统计上的交互效应，以及人与机器的往来。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a rope pulled from both ends, knotted in the middle.
core.cn: 核心意象：一根两端都在拉的绳，中间打了结。

branches.en: THE SHOP DOOR: small exchanges between neighbours.
branches.cn: 店门这条线：邻里之间的小小往来。

branches.en: THE COAST: wind and water make one shape together.
branches.cn: 海岸这条线：风与水共同造出一个形状。

branches.en: THE STUDY: one factor changes another's effect.
branches.cn: 研究这条线：一个因素改变另一因素的作用。

branches.en: THE SCREEN: a tap and a reply count as a social act.
branches.cn: 屏幕这条线：一点一回应被当作社交动作。

branches.en: THE LINK: machines join human social habits.
branches.cn: 连接线：机器进入了人的社交习惯。

intro.en: Interaction = inter- "between" + act- "do" + -ion.
intro.cn: interaction = inter-「在……之间」+ act-「做」+ -ion。

latinIntro.en: Latin inter and agere are attested; the modern noun is English-built.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 inter 与 agere 有记载，这个近代名词是英语自行构成。

items.example: It makes the action mutual.
From agere, also in agent.
It names the process.
It forms interactive.
It forms interactional.
It forms interactively.
It forms reaction, the one-way cousin.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 reaction，只回不互的表亲。

items.example: It allows multi-interaction in new writing.
items.exampleCN: 它使新写作里能说多方互动。

definition_zh: 兴趣；利益；利息；v. 使感兴趣
definition_en: the feeling of wanting to know more about something, an advantage you gain, or money paid for the use of money
core_image: 一个人把头探过桌边，眼睛跟着别人手里的书页一起移动
scene: 少年挤在人群外圈，踮着脚看摊主手上的老式钟表，舍不得走。The bank pays a little interest on that account each month.
sceneCN: 这里 interest 是「兴趣」（第 1 个义项：想知道更多的心情），句意银行每月给那个账户付一点利息，用的是第 2 个义项。画面里的物件：老式钟表、踮起的脚、存折。

pos.zh: 名词：兴趣；利益；利息；股份
动词：使感兴趣；引起（某人）注意

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ing 构成，义为「有趣的」
由过去分词转作形容词，义为「感兴趣的」
由 interesting 加 -ly 构成，义为「有趣的是」
由否定前缀 dis- 加过去分词构成，义为「不带私利的」

senses.title: Wanting to know more
senses.definition: a feeling of curiosity or attention that makes you want to know more about something
senses.definitionCN: 一种好奇或注意的心情，使你想对某事了解更多
senses.example: His interest in old watches began at a street market.
senses.exampleCN: 他对旧钟表的兴趣始于一个街头小市集。
senses.why: Latin interest means "it is between", that is, it makes a difference to someone.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 interest 意为「它在其间」，即与人有关、对人有差别。

senses.title: Money paid for money
senses.definition: the money that a borrower pays to a lender for the use of the money over time
senses.definitionCN: 借用人因使用这笔钱而按时间付给放款人的钱
senses.example: A small loan at seven per cent interest adds up quickly.
senses.exampleCN: 百分之七利率的小额贷款很快就滚出不少钱。
senses.why: Roman law made it profitable to have a stake in a loan, and interest came to mean that stake.
senses.whyCN: 罗马法使在借贷中占一份成为有利可图之事，interest 遂指这「一份」。

senses.title: What is good for you
senses.definition: the advantage or benefit of a person or group
senses.definitionCN: 个人或团体的好处与得益
senses.example: The road was closed in the interest of safety.
senses.exampleCN: 这条路为了安全而被封闭。
senses.why: What makes a difference to you is also what serves your advantage.
senses.whyCN: 对你有差别的事，也就是对你有利的事。

senses.title: A share in a business
senses.definition: a legal share or stake in a company or property
senses.definitionCN: 在公司或财产中的合法份额
senses.example: She sold her interest in the shop to her partner.
senses.exampleCN: 她把店里的股份卖给了合伙人。
senses.why: From a stake in a loan the word widened to any ownership share.
senses.whyCN: 从借贷中的一份，此词扩展到任何所有权份额。

senses.title: To draw attention
senses.definition: to make someone want to know or take part
senses.definitionCN: 使某人想了解或参与
senses.example: The teacher interested the class in the old maps on the wall.
senses.exampleCN: 老师让全班对墙上的旧地图产生了兴趣。
senses.why: The verb reverses the noun: it plants the curiosity instead of feeling it.
senses.whyCN: 动词把名词反过来用：不是产生好奇，而是种下好奇。

intro.en: Interest began as the Latin verb phrase interest "it makes a difference", from inter and esse "to be".
intro.cn: interest 起初是拉丁语动词短语 interest「与之有关」，由 inter 与 esse「存在」构成。

items.en: Interest is literally "it is between", used in phrases like interest reipublicae, it matters to the state.
items.cn: interest 字面是「它在中间」，见于 interest reipublicae 等短语，意谓对国家有干系。

items.en: Roman law compensated a lender for the delay in repayment, weighing what it mattered to him.
items.cn: 罗马法就延迟还款补偿放款人，衡量的正是此事对他有多大干系。

items.en: French interest narrowed to mean money paid for the use of money.
items.cn: 法语 interest 窄化为为使用金钱而付的钱。

items.en: English took interest in the sixteenth century for both money and advantage.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪借入 interest，兼指利息与好处。

items.en: The sense of curiosity appeared later and became the commonest use of all.
items.cn: 「好奇」这一义项较晚出现，却成了最常见用法。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin verb esse "to be"; the near-meaning group holds other words for attention and money.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语动词 esse「存在」；近义组收表示注意与钱财的词。

entries.definition: The adjective for things that hold attention.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，形容能吸引注意的事物。

entries.definition: The adjective for the person who feels interest.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，形容感到兴趣的人。

entries.definition: Free from personal gain, not merely bored.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「无利害关系的」，并非「不感兴趣」。

entries.definition: The wish to know, without any stake.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「好奇心」，不带利益。

entries.definition: An advantage, especially as a right.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「益处」，尤指应得的权利。

entries.definition: Money made from a business after costs.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「利润」，扣除成本后的所赚。

normalIntro.en: The hooks run from the phrase "it matters to me" to the exact phrases interest lives in.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从「这事与我有关」一路走到 interest 的真实搭配。

normal.en: Interest first meant "it is between": it stands between a person and a thing.
normal.cn: interest 最早意为「在其中间」：站在人与事物之间。

normal.en: Be interested in a topic, take an interest in a hobby.
normal.cn: 对话题用 be interested in，对爱好用 take an interest in。

normal.en: Interest on a loan is your stake in the lender's delay.
normal.cn: 贷款的利息就是你对放款人拖延所占的那一份。

normal.en: In the interest of safety, the road was closed.
normal.cn: 为了安全，这条路被封闭。

normal.en: A conflict of interest means two gains pull against each other.
normal.cn: 利益冲突指的是两份好处互相拉扯。

abstract.en: Interest is the thread that ties attention to advantage.
abstract.cn: 兴趣是把注意力与好处系在一起的那根线。

abstract.en: Money grows by interest; the mind grows by interest too.
abstract.cn: 钱靠利息增长，心也靠兴趣增长。

abstract.en: What matters to you will always hold your eyes.
abstract.cn: 与你有关的事总会牵住你的眼睛。

examples.en: Her interest in birds began with a single nest outside the window.
examples.cn: 她对鸟的兴趣始于窗外的一个鸟巢。

examples.en: The loan is repaid with interest over five years.
examples.cn: 这笔贷款在五年内连本带息还清。

examples.en: He acted in the interest of the whole village, not himself.
examples.cn: 他是为整个村子而非自己行事。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因戳瑞斯特」——因被戳到痒处，立刻来了兴趣

root: 拉丁语 inter「在……之间」+ esse「存在」→ 动词短语 interest「与之有关」→ 古法语 interest → 英语 interest。同族：interesting、interested。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses: curiosity, money for money, advantage, a share in a business, and the verb of arousing curiosity.
sensesIntro.cn: 五个义项：好奇、钱生钱的利息、好处、生意里的份额，以及使人上心的动词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person leaning forward, eyes following someone else's book.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人探身向前，眼睛跟着别人手里的书走。

branches.en: THE MARKET STALL: curiosity makes the boy stop walking.
branches.cn: 小摊这条线：好奇心让少年停住脚。

branches.en: THE SAVINGS BOOK: money earns money over time.
branches.cn: 存折这条线：钱随时间再生钱。

branches.en: THE CLOSED ROAD: a benefit is weighed against a cost.
branches.cn: 封闭的路这条线：好处要与代价权衡。

branches.en: THE SOLD SHARE: ownership is the same stake in property.
branches.cn: 卖出的股份这条线：所有权即财产中的一份。

branches.en: THE OLD MAPS: a teacher plants the curiosity.
branches.cn: 旧地图这条线：老师把好奇种下去。

intro.en: Interest has no living prefix-and-suffix split in English: it is frozen Latin, inter "between" plus the verb "to be".
intro.cn: interest 在英语里已无活的词缀可分，是一块冻结的拉丁语：inter「在……之间」加「存在」动词。

latinIntro.en: Latin interest and the phrase interest reipublicae are recorded; only the deepest IE layer is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 interest 与短语 interest reipublicae 均有记载，只有最深的印欧层是重构。

items.example: It places the matter among people.
items.exampleCN: 它把这件事安放在人与人之间。

items.example: The verb behind est and interest.
items.exampleCN: est 与 interest 背后的动词。

items.example: The frozen source of the English word.
It forms interesting.
It forms interested.
It forms disinterested, free of gain.
It forms interestingly.
It gives interests.

definition_zh: 内部的；体内的；国内的；内心的
definition_en: existing or happening inside a person, object, organization, or country rather than outside it
core_image: 一层外壳包着的内腔，所有零件都在壳里面转动
scene: 修车师傅打开引擎盖，用手电照进机件之间的缝里。The internal parts of the engine need a full check.
sceneCN: 这里 internal 是「内部的」（第 1 个义项：位于物体里侧的），句意为引擎的内部零件需要全面检查。画面里的物件：引擎盖、手电、齿轮。

pos.zh: 形容词：内部的；体内的；国内的；内心的

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ly 构成，义为「在内部；内心里」
由本词加 -ity 构成，义为「内在性」
以 extern- 词根加 -al 构成的反义词，义为「外部的」
由同一词根构成，义为「扣押；做实习医生」

senses.title: Inside an object
senses.definition: located or happening inside a physical object rather than on its surface
senses.definitionCN: 位于某个实物内部，而不在其表面上
senses.example: A crack in the internal wall went unnoticed for years.
senses.exampleCN: 内墙里的一道裂缝多年无人发现。
senses.why: Latin internus meant "inward" and was built on the same in- as in, inside.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 internus 意为「向内的」，和 in、inside 共用同一个 in-。

senses.title: Inside the body
senses.definition: relating to the organs and processes hidden within a living body
senses.definitionCN: 与活体内部隐藏的器官及其运作有关的
senses.example: The doctor worried about internal bleeding after the fall.
senses.exampleCN: 摔伤之后医生担心有内出血。
senses.why: Anatomy borrowed the spatial word: whatever lies beneath the skin is internal.
senses.whyCN: 解剖学借用了这个表示空间的词：皮肤底下的一切都叫 internal。

senses.title: Inside a country or group
senses.definition: belonging to the affairs of one country or organization, not involving outsiders
senses.definitionCN: 属于一个国家或组织自身事务、不涉及外部者的
senses.example: Internal trade rose while exports fell.
senses.exampleCN: 出口下降，国内贸易却增长了。
senses.why: Politics extended the shell metaphor to borders: things inside the border are internal.
senses.whyCN: 政治把这个「外壳」比喻扩展到国界：边界之内的事就是内部的。

senses.title: Inside the mind
senses.definition: existing in a person's private thoughts and feelings rather than being shown
senses.definitionCN: 存在于个人私下的想法与情感中而非表现出来的
senses.example: She fought an internal battle before answering the letter.
senses.exampleCN: 回那封信之前，她心里打了一场仗。
senses.why: The last step turns the word inward again, now to the mind rather than the body.
senses.whyCN: 最后一转又把词收回内部，只不过这回指心灵而非身体。

intro.en: Internal is a Latin adjective of location that English adopted whole in the sixteenth century.
intro.cn: internal 是拉丁语中表示位置的形容词，十六世纪被英语整体吸收。

items.en: The preposition in meant "in, within".
items.cn: 介词 in 意为「在……之中」。

items.en: From it came the adjective internus, "situated within".
items.cn: 由它产生形容词 internus，义为「位于内部的」。

items.en: English took internus through French forms as internal in the sciences.
items.cn: 英语经由法语形式把 internus 引入，并在科学文献中写作 internal。

items.en: Anatomy and law used internal for organs and for home affairs.
items.cn: 解剖学与法律分别用 internal 指内脏与内政。

items.en: Modern psychology added the inward, private sense of the mind.
items.cn: 现代心理学又添上「内心、私密」这一层意思。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the in- prefix; the near-meaning group holds words for what is hidden inside.
note.cn: 形近组共用 in- 前缀；近义组收表示「藏在里面」的词。

entries.definition: A trainee or, as a verb, to confine someone.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「实习生」，动词义为「扣押」。

entries.definition: The inside part of something, often of a building.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「内部」，常指房屋内部。

entries.definition: Very close and personal in relationship.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「亲密的」，指关系亲近。

entries.definition: The nearer of two parts; the mental or secret side.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「内部的；内心的」，偏口语。

entries.definition: Of the home or of one's own country.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「家里的；国内的」。

entries.definition: Kept out of sight on purpose or by accident.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「隐藏的」，强调看不见。

normalIntro.en: These hooks tie the word to things you already open up and look inside.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把它挂在你已经会拆开往里看的东西上。

normal.en: in- in internal is the same in- as in inside.
normal.cn: internal 里的 in- 和 inside 里的 in- 是同一个。

normal.en: Add -al and a place becomes a quality: inside, therefore internal.
normal.cn: 加 -al 把位置变成性质：在里面，所以是内部的。

normal.en: Internal organs are the ones you cannot see.
normal.cn: internal organs 就是那些你看不见的器官。

normal.en: An internal email goes to staff only.
normal.cn: internal email 只发给本单位的人。

normal.en: Its mirror twin is external, with ex- for outside.
normal.cn: 它的镜像词是 external，用 ex- 表示外面。

abstract.en: Internal means the shell is doing the hiding.
abstract.cn: internal 的意思是那层壳在替你遮蔽。

abstract.en: A country's internal affairs are its own conversation.
abstract.cn: 一国的内部事务是它自己的对话。

abstract.en: The mind has an internal weather only its owner feels.
abstract.cn: 心灵有一片只有本人才感觉得到的内部天气。

examples.en: The company held an internal review of the failed launch.
examples.cn: 公司对那次失败的发布做了内部复盘。

examples.en: Internal doors should be wide enough for a wheelchair.
examples.cn: 室内的门应宽到能过轮椅。

examples.en: He kept his internal doubts away from the team.
examples.cn: 他把心里的疑虑藏着，没让团队看出来。

dict_mnemonic.text: in（里面）+ tern + al——一切往「里」看都叫内部

root: 拉丁语 in「在内」→ internus「位于内部的」→ 英语 internal。反义为 external（ex-「在外」），同族有 intern、interior、internally。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: inside a thing, inside a body, inside a country or group, and inside a mind.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：物体之内、身体之内、一国或团体之内，以及内心之中。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: everything that stays behind the outer shell.
core.cn: 核心意象：留在外壳之内的一切。

branches.en: THE BOX: what lies within a physical object.
branches.cn: 盒子这条线：实物里侧的部分。

branches.en: THE BODY: organs kept under the skin.
branches.cn: 身体这条线：皮肤下面的器官。

branches.en: THE BORDER: affairs kept within one country.
branches.cn: 国界这条线：留在一国之内的政务。

branches.en: THE MIND: feelings never shown outside.
branches.cn: 心灵这条线：从未向外表露的情绪。

branches.en: THE LINK: both senses hide something behind a surface.
branches.cn: 连接线：两个义项都把东西藏在一个表面之后。

intro.en: Internal splits into the prefix in- "within", the stem intern-, and the adjective ending -al.
intro.cn: internal 可拆为前缀 in-「在内」、词干 intern- 与形容词词尾 -al。

latinIntro.en: Latin in and internus are recorded; the deeper root is shared with inside.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 in 与 internus 均有记载，更深层词根与 inside 同源。

items.example: The prefix marks the inside of a boundary.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀标出边界的内侧。

items.example: The stem carries the sense of location.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干承载位置意义。

items.example: It turns a place word into a quality.
items.exampleCN: 它把位置词变成性质词。

items.example: The adjective is the direct source.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词是直接来源。

items.example: The same stem names someone training inside a hospital.
items.exampleCN: 同一词干指在医院内部受训的人。

items.example: The comparative form of the same stem means the inner part.
items.exampleCN: 同一词干的比较级形式表示里侧。

items.example: It builds the opposite of in-.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 in- 的反义前缀。

items.example: The mirror word replaces in- with ex-.
items.exampleCN: 镜像词把 in- 换成了 ex-。

definition_zh: 国际的；国际性的；国际比赛
definition_en: involving two or more countries, or belonging to the whole world rather than one nation
core_image: 一张长桌，桌边插着好几面不同颜色的国旗
scene: 会议厅里长桌两侧坐着不同语言的代表，同声传译耳机排成一行。The treaty became international law after the vote.
sceneCN: 这里 international 是「国际的」（第 1 个义项：涉及多个国家的），句意为表决之后该条约成了国际法。画面里的物件：长桌、国旗、传译耳机。

pos.zh: 形容词：国际的；国际性的
名词：国际比赛；国际组织成员

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ly 构成，义为「在国际上」
由本词加 -ism 构成，义为「国际主义」
由本词加 -ize 构成，义为「使国际化」
去前缀 nation 加 -al 构成，义为「国家的」

senses.title: Between nations
senses.definition: existing or happening between two or more countries
senses.definitionCN: 存在于或发生在两个以上国家之间的
senses.example: Both sides signed an international agreement on fishing rights.
senses.exampleCN: 双方签署了一份关于捕鱼权的国际协议。
senses.why: The prefix inter- means between, so the word literally places something between nations.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 inter- 意为「之间」，所以这个词字面上就是把某物放在各国之间。

senses.title: Open to many countries
senses.definition: made up of or open to people and groups from many nations
senses.definitionCN: 由许多国家的人或团体组成、或向他们开放的
senses.example: The orchestra has an international cast of players.
senses.exampleCN: 这个乐团的演奏者来自许多国家。
senses.why: If something lies between nations, it naturally gathers people from all of them.
senses.whyCN: 既然位于各国之间，自然就会把各国的人都聚到一起。

senses.title: Competition or body
senses.definition: a match between national teams, or an organization with member states
senses.definitionCN: 国家代表队之间的比赛，或有成员国参加的组织
senses.example: He won three internationals before he turned twenty.
senses.exampleCN: 他二十岁前赢了三场国际比赛。
senses.why: As a noun the adjective needed no new shape: the games themselves became internationals.
senses.whyCN: 作名词时形容词不必变形：这类比赛就被叫作 internationals。

intro.en: International was coined in English in the late eighteenth century by adding inter- to national.
intro.cn: international 是十八世纪晚期英语在 national 前加 inter- 新造的词。

items.en: Inter meant "between" and nasci "to be born".
items.cn: inter 意为「之间」，nasci 意为「出生」。

items.en: Nation entered French from Latin natio, a people born together.
items.cn: nation 从拉丁语 natio「同出生的一群人」进入法语。

items.en: English used national for what belongs to one people.
items.cn: 英语用 national 表示属于一个民族或国家的。

items.en: Jeremy Bentham coined international for law that binds nations.
items.cn: 杰里米·边沁造出 international，指约束各国的法律。

items.en: From law the word spread to trade, sport, and organizations.
items.cn: 这个词从法律扩展到贸易、体育与各类组织。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the same inter- and nat- parts; the near-meaning group holds words about worldwide scale.
note.cn: 形近组共用 inter- 与 nat- 两部分；近义组收表示全球范围的词。

entries.definition: Belonging to one country only.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「国家的；民族的」，只属于一国。

entries.definition: Happening inside one country or object.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「内部的」，强调在内部。

entries.definition: A period of time between two events.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「间隔」，指两事之间的时间。

entries.definition: Covering the whole world as a single unit.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「全球的」，强调整体范围。

entries.definition: Spread through every part of the world.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「遍及全世界的」。

entries.definition: Operating in several countries at once.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「跨国的」，指同时在多国运作。

normalIntro.en: These hooks break the word into pieces you already know.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把它拆成你早已熟悉的几块。

normal.en: inter- means between; national means of a nation.
normal.cn: inter- 是「之间」，national 是「国家的」。

normal.en: Put them together: what sits between nations.
normal.cn: 合起来：坐在各国之间的东西。

normal.en: An international airport serves flights from other countries.
normal.cn: 国际机场接待来自别国的航班。

normal.en: Drop inter- and you are back to one country.
normal.cn: 去掉 inter- 就退回一个国家。

normal.en: The word was born in law, not in sport.
normal.cn: 这个词先在法律里出生，而不是体育。

abstract.en: International is the gap turned into a meeting room.
abstract.cn: 国际就是那道缝隙被改造成一间会议室。

abstract.en: A border is a line; international is what crosses it.
abstract.cn: 边界是一条线；国际是跨过这条线的一切。

abstract.en: Many flags, one word on the door.
abstract.cn: 许多面国旗，门牌上只写一个词。

examples.en: She works for an international charity in Geneva.
examples.cn: 她在日内瓦一家国际慈善机构工作。

examples.en: International calls cost extra on that plan.
examples.cn: 那个套餐里国际长途要另外收费。

examples.en: The match was his first international at this level.
examples.cn: 这场比赛是他在这一级别的首次国际赛事。

dict_mnemonic.text: inter（之间）+ nation（国家）+ al——国家之间的

root: 拉丁语 inter「之间」+ natio「出生、族群」→ 古法语 nation → 英语 national → 加 inter- 成 international。同族有 nation、national、internationally。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: between nations, made of many nations, and as a noun for big matches or bodies.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：国与国之间的、由多国组成的，以及作名词指国际赛事或组织。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a room where more than one flag stands at the table.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张桌边立着不止一面国旗的房间。

branches.en: THE TREATY: agreements that bind more than one state.
branches.cn: 条约这条线：约束不止一个国家的协定。

branches.en: THE TEAM: people drawn from many countries.
branches.cn: 团队这条线：来自许多国家的人。

branches.en: THE FIXTURE: a match or a body named for its scope.
branches.cn: 赛事这条线：以范围命名的比赛或组织。

branches.en: THE FRAME: both senses hang on what lies beyond one border.
branches.cn: 框架线：两个义项都挂在同一条边界之外。

branches.en: THE STAGE: a shared stage makes both the team and the match possible.
branches.cn: 舞台线：共用的舞台让团队与比赛都成为可能。

intro.en: International is inter- "between" plus national, where nat- means born.
intro.cn: international 是 inter-「之间」加 national，其中 nat- 意为「出生」。

latinIntro.en: Latin inter and natio are recorded; the verb nasci is the oldest member.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 inter 与 natio 均有记载，动词 nasci 是这一族最古老的成员。

items.example: It marks what sits between two sides.
items.exampleCN: 它标出位于两侧之间的东西。

items.example: The root also appears in native and nature.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根也见于 native 与 nature。

items.example: The noun grew into the modern nation.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词演变成现代的 nation。

items.example: It makes national out of nation.
items.exampleCN: 它把 nation 变成 national。

items.example: The noun names one political community.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词指一个政治共同体。

items.example: The word adds inter- to this adjective.
items.exampleCN: 本词就是在这个形容词前加 inter-。

items.example: It forms internationally.
It forms internationalism.

definition_zh: 互联网；因特网；网络接入与线上世界
definition_en: the worldwide system of interconnected computer networks that uses common protocols to carry data
core_image: 地球表面密布着无数台计算机与海底光缆，数据包沿着这些线路在洲际之间一跳一跳地前进
scene: 深夜的书房里，学生戴上耳机，屏幕上来自另一座城市的课程视频几乎立刻加载完成。The Internet carries the lecture across continents in seconds.
sceneCN: 这里指把全球计算机网络连成一体、承载数据传输的系统（第 1 个义项：全球互联网）；句意：互联网在几秒内把这堂课传过多个大洲。

pos.zh: 互联网；因特网；网络接入

derivatives.zh: 由该名词加表示「以……为基础」的形容词成分构成，义为「基于互联网的」
由该名词加表示「使能够」的已完成词尾构成，义为「具备联网功能的」
由表示「内部」的拉丁前缀替换首段构成，义为「机构内部网络」
由表示「外部」的拉丁前缀替换首段构成，义为「对合作方开放的内部网络」
该词后半的缩略形式，义为「网络」

senses.title: The worldwide network of networks
senses.definition: the global system that joins countless local and national networks through shared protocols
senses.definitionCN: 通过共同协议把无数地方性与国家级网络连成一体的全球系统
senses.example: The internet links universities on every continent.
senses.exampleCN: 互联网把各大洲的大学连接起来。
senses.why: The name says what it is: a net that sits between other nets and lets them reach one another.
senses.whyCN: 这个名字直说其本质：一张位于其他网络之间、让它们互通的网。

senses.title: A service you subscribe to
senses.definition: the connection to the global network that a household or business buys from a provider
senses.definitionCN: 家庭或企业向服务商购买、用于接入全球网络的连接服务
senses.example: The village finally got internet last winter.
senses.exampleCN: 这个村子去年冬天终于通上了网络。
senses.why: People meet the system through a paid link, so the mass noun also names the service rather than the whole architecture.
senses.whyCN: 人们是通过付费连接接触到这个系统的，因此这个不可数名词也指服务，而不只是整套架构。

senses.title: The online world people inhabit
senses.definition: the space of websites, messages and communities reached through the network
senses.definitionCN: 通过网络访问的网站、信息与社群所构成的空间
senses.example: She found the answer somewhere on the internet.
senses.exampleCN: 她在网上某处找到了答案。
senses.why: Once access is routine, the word shifts from the machinery to the place-like experience of being online.
senses.whyCN: 当接入成为日常，这个词便从机器设施转向「在网上」那种空间化的体验。

senses.title: Any interconnection of networks
senses.definition: the general technical condition in which separate networks are joined, often written without the capital
senses.definitionCN: 彼此独立的网络被连接起来的一般技术状态，常以小写形式书写
senses.example: Two research internet links now carry the telescope data.
senses.exampleCN: 两条研究网络互联链路现在承载着望远镜数据。
senses.why: Before it named one global system, the word was a plain description of interconnecting nets, and that technical sense survives.
senses.whyCN: 在它专指一个全球系统之前，这个词只是「网络互联」的普通描述，这一技术义至今仍在。

senses.title: The medium that carries content
senses.definition: the network understood as a channel through which media, trade and speech are delivered
senses.definitionCN: 被理解为传送媒体、交易与言论的通道的网络
senses.example: Radio survived by moving its audience to the internet.
senses.exampleCN: 广播通过把听众转移到互联网上而存活下来。
senses.why: A network that carries data can be described by what it carries, so the word also names a medium.
senses.whyCN: 承载数据的网络可以从「承载什么」来描述，因此这个词也指一种媒介。

senses.title: The link itself
senses.definition: the active connection between a device and the network, as in having or losing it
senses.definitionCN: 设备与网络之间正在生效的连接，如「有网」或「断网」
senses.example: My phone lost internet halfway through the call.
senses.exampleCN: 通话到一半时我的手机断了网。
senses.why: The whole system is only present to a user through a live link, so the word can name that link.
senses.whyCN: 对用户而言，整个系统只通过一条生效的链路显现，因此这个词可以指那条链路。

senses.title: The industry built around it
senses.definition: the businesses, platforms and jobs that depend on the network
senses.definitionCN: 依赖该网络运作的企业、平台与岗位
senses.example: Advertising moved most of its budget to the internet.
senses.exampleCN: 广告业把大部分预算转向了互联网。
senses.why: An infrastructure with its own economy is naturally named by the same word, as in internet companies.
senses.whyCN: 拥有自身经济形态的基础设施自然沿用同一个词来命名，如网络公司。

senses.title: The store of online material
senses.definition: the accumulated pages, records and data reachable through the network
senses.definitionCN: 通过网络可以访问的网页、记录与数据的累积总和
senses.example: The whole archive is now on the internet.
senses.exampleCN: 整个档案现在都放在了网上。
senses.why: If the network holds the material, speakers treat the medium as the store, giving this collective sense.
senses.whyCN: 如果网络承载着这些材料，说话人就会把媒介当作仓库，于是有了这一集合义。

intro.en: Internet is a twentieth-century compound of Latin inter, meaning between, and English net, a clipping of network; the capital letter once marked a single global system.
intro.cn: 这个词是二十世纪的复合词：拉丁语「在……之间」加英语「网络」的缩略；首字母大写曾用来标记那个唯一的全球系统。

items.en: Inter meant between or among, and it survives in many English words for things that sit between others.
items.cn: 这个词缀意为「在……之间」或「在……之中」，在许多表示「位于其间」的英语词中留存。

items.en: Net was already a short word for a network, especially a network of computers or communications.
items.cn: 「网」早已是网络的简短说法，尤其指计算机或通信网络。

items.en: The first packet-switching network linked a handful of research sites, and similar networks soon appeared in other countries.
items.cn: 第一个分组交换网络连接了几个研究站点，类似网络很快在其他国家出现。

items.en: The compound was formed to name the linking of separate networks, and it soon became the ordinary word for the global system.
items.cn: 人们造出这个复合词来指独立网络的互联，它很快成为指称全球系统的普通词。

items.en: Style guides long insisted on a capital letter for the single global system and a small letter for any interconnection of networks; everyday use now blurs the two.
items.cn: 旧式规范坚持：指唯一的全球系统时首字母大写，指任意网络互联时小写；日常使用如今已把两者混同。

items.en: The exact first use and the identity of the coiner are not settled; the date around 1972 is generally accepted, but earlier and independent formations have been claimed.
items.cn: 确切的首次使用与造词者尚无定论；约 1972 年这一年代为一般接受，但更早或独立造词的用法也有人主张。

note.en: The first group shares the net idea at different scales; the second group names the online world under other aspects.
note.cn: 第一组是不同尺度上的「网」；第二组从其他侧面指称线上世界。

entries.definition: A private network inside an organization, built with the same technology but closed to outsiders.
entries.definitionCN: 机构内部的专用网络，技术相同但对外封闭。

entries.definition: A private network opened to selected outside partners, sitting between an intranet and the public network.
entries.definitionCN: 向特定外部合作方开放的专用网络，介于内部网络与公共网络之间。

entries.definition: One linked system; the internet is the network that joins many such systems.
entries.definitionCN: 单个互联系统；而互联网是把许多这样的系统连起来的那张网。

entries.definition: To join networks to one another, the action behind the name.
entries.definitionCN: 把网络彼此连接，正是名称背后的动作。

entries.definition: The online world imagined as a place; it stresses experience and culture rather than cables.
entries.definitionCN: 把线上世界想象成一个场所；强调体验与文化，而非线缆。

entries.definition: The linked pages and services built on the network; it is one layer, not the whole system.
entries.definitionCN: 建立在该网络之上的网页与服务；它只是其中一层，不是整个系统。

entries.definition: Being connected and active on a network; it describes a state rather than naming the system.
entries.definitionCN: 已连接并在网络上活动；描述状态，而不是命名系统。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real Latin and English pieces and real fixed phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁语与英语成分，以及真实固定搭配。

normal.en: Inter means between, so the internet is the net between nets.
normal.cn: 「之间」加上「网」，互联网就是网与网之间的那张网。

normal.en: The family runs internet, intranet, extranet, interconnect and internetwork.
normal.cn: 同族词包括互联网、内部网络、外部专用网络、互联与网际网络。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark access: internet access, internet connection, internet service.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出接入：互联网接入、网络连接、互联网服务。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark scale: internet traffic, internet user, internet address.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出规模：网络流量、互联网用户、网络地址。

normal.en: The capital letter used to say that there is only one such global system.
normal.cn: 首字母大写过去用来表示这样的全球系统只有一个。

abstract.en: Picture a city where every street ends at a station that also leads to every other city.
abstract.cn: 想象一座城市，每条街的尽头都有一个通往其他所有城市的车站。

abstract.en: Picture a library whose shelves are in many buildings but share one catalogue.
abstract.cn: 想象一座图书馆，书架分散在许多建筑里，却共用一份目录。

abstract.en: Picture a conversation in which every sentence can reach every listener at once.
abstract.cn: 想象一场对话，每句话都能同时传到每一位听众那里。

examples.en: The internet was designed to keep working even when one route failed.
examples.cn: 互联网的设计目标是即使某条线路失效也能继续工作。

examples.en: Many rural clinics still lack reliable internet.
examples.cn: 许多乡村诊所仍然缺乏稳定的网络接入。

examples.en: He taught himself the language entirely on the internet.
examples.cn: 他完全靠在网上自学了这门语言。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因特」近「之间」加「网」——网与网之间连成的那张网

root: 拉丁语「在……之间」加英语「网络」的缩略；约 1972 年组合成词。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses move from the global architecture to the service, the online world, the plain technical sense, the medium, the active link, the industry and the stored material.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从全球架构出发，依次落到服务、线上世界、纯技术义、媒介、生效链路、产业与所存资料。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: many separate networks joined so that any point can reach any other point.
core.cn: 核心意象：许多独立网络被连接起来，使任意一点都能到达另一点。

branches.en: THE SYSTEM ITSELF: the global network of networks, the sense that anchors all the others.
branches.cn: 系统本身：全球的网络之网，是支撑其余义项的锚点。

branches.en: THE LINK A USER HAS: a paid service or a live connection that stands between a device and the system.
branches.cn: 用户拥有的链路：付费服务或生效连接，位于设备与系统之间。

branches.en: THE PLACE IT FEELS LIKE: the online world of sites, messages and communities.
branches.cn: 它带来的场所感：网站、信息与社群构成的线上世界。

branches.en: THE TECHNICAL READING: any joining of separate networks, written without the capital.
branches.cn: 技术读法：任意独立网络的互联，通常小写书写。

branches.en: WHAT IT CARRIES AND SUPPORTS: a medium for content, an industry around it, and a store of reachable material.
branches.cn: 它所承载与支撑的：内容媒介、围绕它的产业，以及可访问资料的总和。

intro.en: Internet is Latin inter plus English net; the prefix is productive, while the base is a native clipping.
intro.cn: 这个词由拉丁语前缀「之间」加英语「网」的缩略构成；前缀能产，词基是英语本族缩略。

latinIntro.en: The only Latin element is the prefix inter; the base net is English, so Latin cognates are listed for the prefix alone.
latinIntro.cn: 唯一的拉丁成分是前缀「之间」；词基「网」来自英语，因此只为前缀列出拉丁同族。

items.example: The prefix places the network between other networks.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把这张网放在其他网络之间。

items.example: The base is the short English word for a network.
items.exampleCN: 词基是英语中「网络」的简短说法。

items.example: The compound names the joining of separate networks.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合词指独立网络的互联。

items.example: An intranet serves only the staff of one organization.
items.exampleCN: 内部网络只为一个机构的员工服务。

items.meaning: a network opened to selected outsiders
items.meaningCN: 对特定外部方开放的网络
items.example: An extranet lets partners see part of the system.
items.exampleCN: 外部专用网络让合作方看到系统的一部分。

items.example: Engineers interconnect the two campus networks.
items.exampleCN: 工程师把两个校园网连接起来。

items.meaningCN: 由多个网络互联而成的系统
items.example: The term describes the architecture in general.
items.exampleCN: 这个词泛指这种互联架构。

items.example: An internet-based service needs no local server.
items.exampleCN: 基于互联网的服务不需要本地服务器。

derivatives.zh: 由表示「内部」的拉丁前缀替换首段构成，义为「机构内部网络」
由表示「外部」的拉丁前缀替换首段构成，义为「对外部合作方开放的网络」
由表示「之间」的前缀加「连接」的动词构成，义为「使互联」
由该名词加表示「以……为基础」的词尾构成，义为「基于互联网的」

definition_en: to explain the meaning of something, to understand it in a particular way, or to translate speech aloud
core_image: 两个人隔着一道模糊的玻璃，中间站着一个人把话从一边递到另一边
scene: 会议室里，译员戴着耳机，把发言人刚说完的一段话轻声转成另一种语言。She had to interpret the silence as agreement.
sceneCN: 这里 interpret 是「解释、理解」（第 1 个义项：给含义作出说明），句意为她只好把那阵沉默理解成同意。画面里的物件：耳机、话筒、会议记录。

pos.zh: 动词：解释；理解；口译；演绎

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -er 构成，义为「口译员；解释者」
由本词加 -ation 构成，义为「解释；理解」
由本词加 -ive 构成，义为「解释性的」
由 mis- 加本词构成，义为「误解」

senses.title: Work out the meaning
senses.definition: to explain or decide what something means, especially something unclear
senses.definitionCN: 解释或判定某事物的含义，尤指不清楚的东西
senses.example: There are several ways to interpret this clause.
senses.exampleCN: 这一条款有好几种解释方式。
senses.why: Latin interpres was a go-between who explained one side to the other.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 interpres 是在两边之间替人解释的中间人。

senses.title: Read in a certain way
senses.definition: to understand an action or event in one particular way
senses.definitionCN: 以某一特定方式去理解某个动作或事件
senses.example: He interpreted her silence as refusal.
senses.exampleCN: 他把她沉默理解为拒绝。
senses.why: Once meaning is negotiable, the reader is the one who interprets.
senses.whyCN: 既然意义可以商量，做解释的就成了读者本人。

senses.title: Translate speech aloud
senses.definition: to translate spoken words from one language into another as they are said
senses.definitionCN: 在别人说话的同时把口头话语译成另一种语言
senses.example: She interpreted for the visiting minister all morning.
senses.exampleCN: 她整个上午为来访的部长做口译。
senses.why: The old go-between sense survives most literally here: the go-between still stands between two tongues.
senses.whyCN: 古老的中间人义在这里保留得最直接：中间人仍站在两种语言之间。

senses.title: Perform a role
senses.definition: to perform a piece of music or drama in a way that shows one's own understanding
senses.definitionCN: 以体现个人理解的方式演奏乐曲或演绎戏剧
senses.example: The quartet interpreted the slow movement very freely.
senses.exampleCN: 四重奏把那个慢乐章演绎得很自由。
senses.why: Performance adds a final twist: the player becomes the go-between of the composer.
senses.whyCN: 表演又添了最后一转：演奏者成了作曲家的中间人。

intro.en: Interpret comes from Latin interpres, a negotiator or go-between who explains each side to the other.
intro.cn: interpret 来自拉丁语 interpres，指为两边互相解释的谈判者或中间人。

items.en: Interpres named the middleman who carried words between parties.
items.cn: interpres 指在双方之间传递话语的中间人。

items.en: The verb interpretari meant to explain or negotiate.
items.cn: 动词 interpretari 意为「解释；谈判」。

items.en: Old French interpreter narrowed it towards explaining meaning.
items.cn: 古法语 interpreter 把它收窄到「解释含义」。

items.en: English used interpret for dreams, texts, and laws.
items.cn: 英语用 interpret 指解梦、解文、释法。

items.en: With live translation the word also took on the spoken sense.
items.cn: 随着现场翻译出现，这个词又添上口译义。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the inter- prefix and its noun forms; the near-meaning group holds words about explaining.
note.cn: 形近组共用 inter- 前缀及其名词形式；近义组收表示「说明」的词。

entries.definition: The explanation or reading that results.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「解释；解读」。

entries.definition: The person who translates speech aloud.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「口译员」。

entries.definition: To break in on someone who is speaking.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「打断」，拼写相近。

entries.definition: To make something clear in plain words.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「解释清楚」。

entries.definition: To put words of one language into another.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「翻译」，书面与口头都可用。

entries.definition: To grasp what something means.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「理解」的内心动作。

normalIntro.en: These hooks put the go-between back at the centre of the word.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把「中间人」重新放回这个词的中心。

normal.en: inter- is between; an interpreter stands between two speakers.
normal.cn: inter- 是「之间」；口译员就站在两个说话人之间。

normal.en: To interpret a dream is to translate it into plain sense.
normal.cn: 解梦就是把它翻译成明白的道理。

normal.en: Interpret the look as a hint, and reading becomes a habit.
normal.cn: 把眼神也当成线索去读，阅读就成了习惯。

normal.en: The noun pile grows: interpreter, interpretation, interpretive.
normal.cn: 名词家族壮大：interpreter、interpretation、interpretive。

normal.en: Mis- at the front turns interpret into getting it wrong.
normal.cn: 前面加 mis- 就变成理解错了。

abstract.en: Interpretation is a bridge that only holds one passenger at a time.
abstract.cn: 解释是一座一次只能过一位行人的桥。

abstract.en: Every interpreter lends the speaker a borrowed voice.
abstract.cn: 每个译员都借给说话人一副嗓子。

abstract.en: Meaning does not travel; someone has to carry it.
abstract.cn: 意义不会自己走，总得有人去搬。

examples.en: Good readers interpret a poem before they judge it.
examples.cn: 好的读者先理解一首诗，再评判它。

examples.en: Nobody should interpret a shrug as a yes.
examples.cn: 谁都不该把一个耸肩当成同意。

examples.en: She learned to interpret between Chinese and Spanish.
examples.cn: 她学会了在中西两种语言之间做口译。

dict_mnemonic.text: inter（之间）+ pret（说清楚）——在两边之间把话说明白

root: 拉丁语 interpres「中间人、谈判者」→ interpretari「解释」→ 古法语 interpreter → 英语 interpret。同族有 interpreter、interpretation、misinterpret。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: explain a meaning, read something a certain way, translate speech live, and perform a work.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：阐明含义、按某种方式理解、现场口译，以及演绎作品。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person standing in the gap between two sides and carrying words across.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人站在两方之间的缝里，把话搬过对面。

branches.en: THE GLOSS: making an unclear meaning plain.
branches.cn: 注解这条线：把不清楚的含义讲清楚。

branches.en: THE LENS: every reader puts on a way of seeing.
branches.cn: 透镜这条线：每个读者都戴上一副看法。

branches.en: THE EARPIECE: words carried live across languages.
branches.cn: 耳机这条线：话语被当场搬过语言边界。

branches.en: THE STAGE: the player speaks for the composer.
branches.cn: 舞台这条线：演奏者替作曲家说话。

branches.en: THE LINK: both senses make one meaning reach another person.
branches.cn: 连接线：两个义项都让一种意思抵达另一个人。

intro.en: Interpret holds the prefix inter- "between" and an old Latin stem pret- of uncertain meaning.
intro.cn: interpret 含前缀 inter-「之间」与一个含义不确定的拉丁词干 pret-。

latinIntro.en: Latin interpres and interpretari are recorded; the inner stem is debated by scholars.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 interpres 与 interpretari 均有记载，其内部词干学者有争议。

items.example: It places the action between two parties.
items.exampleCN: 它把动作放在两方之间。

items.example: The stem is debated among etymologists.
items.exampleCN: 词源学者对这个词干有争论。

items.example: The noun is the oldest secure form.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词是现存最古老可靠的形式。

items.example: The verb is the direct source.
It forms interpreter.
It forms interpretation.
It forms misinterpret.
It forms interpretive.

definition_en: an explanation of what something means, a particular way of understanding it, or a performance that shows one's reading
core_image: 同一段旧文字，旁边密密麻麻写着不同颜色的批注，每一层都是一种读法
scene: 学生把同一行诗抄了三遍，每一遍旁边写下自己不同的想法。Her interpretation of the contract was stricter than his.
sceneCN: 这里 interpretation 是「解释、理解」（第 1 个义项：对含义的说明），句意为她对合同的解释比他更严格。画面里的物件：诗稿、彩色批注、放大镜。

pos.zh: 名词：解释；理解；演绎；口译

collocations.phrase: a fresh interpretation of a play

derivatives.zh: 去后缀构成，义为「解释；口译」
由 interpret 加 -ive 构成，义为「解释性的」
由 interpret 加 -er 构成，义为「口译员」
加前缀 mis- 构成，义为「误解」

senses.title: An explanation offered
senses.definition: a statement that explains what something means or how it should be understood
senses.definitionCN: 说明某事物含义或应当如何理解的陈述
senses.example: The guide gave a short interpretation of each symbol.
senses.exampleCN: 讲解员对每个符号都作了简短解释。
senses.why: The Latin -atio turned the act of explaining into a thing you can hand to another.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 -atio 把「解释」这个动作变成可以递给别人的东西。

senses.title: A personal reading
senses.definition: the particular way a person understands a text, event, or action
senses.definitionCN: 某个人理解文本、事件或动作的特定方式
senses.example: Her interpretation of the results differed from the lab's.
senses.exampleCN: 她对结果的解读与实验室的不同。
senses.why: Once explanation is a thing, it can differ from person to person.
senses.whyCN: 解释一旦成了具体的东西，就可能因人而异。

senses.title: A performance
senses.definition: a way of performing a piece of music or drama that reveals the performer's understanding
senses.definitionCN: 体现表演者理解的演奏或戏剧呈现方式
senses.example: The director's interpretation set the play in a factory.
senses.exampleCN: 导演的演绎把这部戏搬进了一家工厂。
senses.why: Performance continued the older sense: the player interprets the work as a text.
senses.whyCN: 表演延续了旧义：演奏者把作品当文本去解释。

senses.title: Live translation
senses.definition: the act of translating speech from one language into another as it happens
senses.definitionCN: 在讲话进行的同时把话语译成另一种语言的活动
senses.example: Simultaneous interpretation requires intense concentration.
senses.exampleCN: 同声传译需要高度专注。
senses.why: The go-between sense of the base verb lives on in this technical noun.
senses.whyCN: 原动词的「中间人」义在这个专业名词里延续下来。

intro.en: Interpretation is the Latin noun of result built on interpretari, the work of a go-between.
intro.cn: interpretation 是建立在 interpretari（中间人的工作）之上的拉丁语结果名词。

items.en: Interpres named the person who carried meaning between parties.
items.cn: interpres 指在双方之间传递含义的人。

items.en: Interpretatio was the explaining that such a person produced.
items.cn: interpretatio 是这类人所做出的解释。

items.en: French interpretation kept the sense of expounding a text.
items.cn: 法语 interpretation 保留了阐述文本的意思。

items.en: The word entered English with law, scripture, and dreams.
items.cn: 这个词随法律、经文与解梦进入英语。

items.en: Modern usage adds performance and conference translation.
items.cn: 现代用法又添上表演与会议翻译。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the interpret- stem; the near-meaning group holds other names for an explanation.
note.cn: 形近组共用 interpret- 词干；近义组收其他表示「说明」的名词。

entries.definition: The verb of explaining or translating.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「解释；口译」。

entries.definition: The person doing it, not the result.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「口译员」，指人而非结果。

entries.definition: The adjective meaning explanatory.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「解释性的」。

entries.definition: The act of making something clear.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「说明」，强调说清楚。

entries.definition: One person's version of what a text means.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「解读」，偏个人理解。

entries.definition: One account of an event among several.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「一种说法」。

normalIntro.en: These hooks work best with the verb interpret, which the noun simply turns into a thing.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子最好和动词 interpret 搭配，名词只是把它变成了一件东西。

normal.en: -ation turns the act into a product: interpret, interpretation.
normal.cn: -ation 把动作变成产物：interpret、interpretation。

normal.en: An interpretation is something you can write down and hand over.
normal.cn: 解释是能写下来、递出去的东西。

normal.en: Two people can hold two interpretations of one sentence.
normal.cn: 一句话可以有两个人各自的解释。

normal.en: Simultaneous interpretation happens in a glass booth.
normal.cn: 同声传译发生在玻璃隔间里。

normal.en: A director's interpretation changes what you see on stage.
normal.cn: 导演的演绎会改变你在台上看到的东西。

abstract.en: A text is a room; an interpretation is the furniture you bring in.
abstract.cn: 文本是一间房，解释是你搬进去的家具。

abstract.en: Every reading leaves fingerprints on the page.
abstract.cn: 每种读法都会在纸上留下指纹。

abstract.en: Meaning is not found; it is handed to you by a reader.
abstract.cn: 含义不是被找到的，是某个读者递给你的。

examples.en: The judge's interpretation of the rule surprised both sides.
examples.cn: 法官对规则的解释让双方都很意外。

examples.en: Her interpretation of the role was quieter than the usual one.
examples.cn: 她对这个角色的演绎比通常的更安静。

examples.en: Their interpretation of the data has been challenged.
examples.cn: 他们对数据的解读受到了质疑。

dict_mnemonic.text: interpret（解释）+ ation（结果）——解释出来的那套说法

root: 拉丁语 interpres「中间人」→ interpretari「解释」→ interpretatio「解释的产物」→ 古法语 → 英语 interpretation。同族有 interpret、interpreter、interpretive。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: an offered explanation, a personal reading, a staged performance, and live translation.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：给出的解释、个人的读法、舞台上的演绎，以及现场口译。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a page covered in coloured notes, each colour a different reader.
core.cn: 核心意象：一页纸上写满各色批注，每种颜色都是一位读者。

branches.en: THE NOTE: the explanation you can hand over.
branches.cn: 便条这条线：可以递出去的解释。

branches.en: THE GLASSES: the reader's own way of seeing.
branches.cn: 眼镜这条线：读者自己的看法。

branches.en: THE STAGE: a work shown through one mind.
branches.cn: 舞台这条线：经由一个人头脑呈现的作品。

branches.en: THE BOOTH: speech carried across languages.
branches.cn: 隔间这条线：话语被搬过语言边界。

branches.en: THE EAR: both senses begin with hearing a meaning first.
branches.cn: 耳朵线：两个义项都先要听见一种含义。

intro.en: Interpretation is interpret plus the Latin noun ending -ation, which names an act or its result.
intro.cn: interpretation 是 interpret 加拉丁名词词尾 -ation，表示行为或其结果。

latinIntro.en: Latin interpretatio and interpretari are recorded forms of this family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 interpretatio 与 interpretari 都是这一族的记载形式。

items.example: It marks the go-between position.
The oldest form in the family.
items.exampleCN: 这一族中最古老的形式。

items.example: The verb supplies the whole stem.
items.exampleCN: 整个词干来自这个动词。

items.example: It turns the verb into a noun.
It forms interpreter in place of the result.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 interpreter，指人而非结果。

items.example: It forms interpretive.
It forms misinterpretation.
It is the shorter form of -ation in translation.
items.exampleCN: 它是 translation 中 -ation 的短形。

definition_en: a period of time between two events, or a space between two things
core_image: 两根柱子之间空出一段距离，阳光正好落在中间那块地面上
scene: 公交车每隔十分钟来一辆，站台上的人看着时刻表估摸下一班。There was a long interval before the doctor came out.
sceneCN: 这里 interval 是「间隔」（第 1 个义项：两个事件之间的时间段），句意为过了很久医生才出来。画面里的物件：时刻表、站台长椅、手表。

pos.zh: 名词：间隔；间歇；幕间休息

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ic 构成，义为「间隔的；音程的」
结构相近的近亲，义为「幕间插曲」

senses.title: Time between events
senses.definition: the length of time separating two events or points
senses.definitionCN: 把两个事件或两个时点隔开的那段时间
senses.example: Buses run here at intervals of fifteen minutes.
senses.exampleCN: 这里的公交车每十五分钟一班。
senses.why: Latin intervallum meant the space between rampart walls.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 intervallum 本指城墙之间的空地。

senses.title: Space between things
senses.definition: the distance or empty space between two objects placed apart
senses.definitionCN: 两件分开放置之物之间的距离或空隙
senses.example: Plant the young trees at wide intervals.
senses.exampleCN: 树苗要按较宽的间距栽种。
senses.why: The word began with space, so this sense is the older picture returning.
senses.whyCN: 这个词本来讲空间，所以这一义项是更古老的画面回来了。

senses.title: A break in a show
senses.definition: a pause between the parts of a performance, when the audience may leave their seats
senses.definitionCN: 演出各部分之间的暂停，观众可以离座
senses.example: We talked about the play during the interval.
senses.exampleCN: 中场休息时我们聊了聊这部戏。
senses.why: A theatre simply uses the time sense for its own calendar of acts.
senses.whyCN: 剧院只是把时间义用在自己分幕的日程上。

senses.title: A gap in pitch
senses.definition: the distance in pitch between two musical notes
senses.definitionCN: 两个音之间在音高上的距离
senses.example: A fifth is the easiest interval to hear.
senses.exampleCN: 五度是最容易听出来的音程。
senses.why: Music measures distance too, so the space word works between notes.
senses.whyCN: 音乐也丈量距离，于是空间词也能用在音符之间。

intro.en: Interval comes from Latin intervallum, the space between two palisades of a camp.
intro.cn: interval 来自拉丁语 intervallum，指军营两道栅栏之间的空地。

items.en: Vallum was the wall of stakes round a camp.
items.cn: vallum 是营寨四周的木桩墙。

items.en: Intervallum was the open space left between walls.
items.cn: intervallum 是两道墙之间留出的空地。

items.en: The word also measured gaps in time and in speech.
items.cn: 这个词也用来量时间与话语中的空档。

items.en: French intervalle carried the spacing sense to English.
items.cn: 法语 intervalle 把「间距」义带入英语。

items.en: Theatres and musicians gave the word its break and pitch senses.
items.cn: 剧院与音乐家又给它添上休息与音程义。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the inter- prefix; the near-meaning group holds words for gaps.
note.cn: 形近组共用 inter- 前缀；近义组收表示空档的词。

entries.definition: Situated inside something.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「内部的」。

entries.definition: Necessary as part of a whole.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「不可缺少的」，拼写相近。

entries.definition: A short piece played between acts.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「幕间曲；插曲」。

entries.definition: An empty space or a missing part.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「缺口；空档」。

entries.definition: A short stop before carrying on.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「停顿」。

entries.definition: A rest between periods of activity.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「休息；间歇」。

normalIntro.en: These hooks keep the picture of two posts with a measured gap between them.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子守着「两根柱子之间量出一段空档」的画面。

normal.en: inter- between plus vallum wall gives the space between walls.
normal.cn: inter-「之间」加 vallum「墙」就是两墙之间的空地。

normal.en: At regular intervals is the phrase of clocks and buses.
normal.cn: at regular intervals 是钟表和公交的说法。

normal.en: The interval in a play is exactly a gap in the action.
normal.cn: 戏里的 interval 正是情节中间的空档。

normal.en: Musicians count the interval between two notes.
normal.cn: 音乐家数两个音之间的音程。

normal.en: Interval, not Internet: the middle letters are -erv- not -ernet-.
normal.cn: 是 interval 不是 internet：中间是 -erv- 而非 -ernet-。

abstract.en: An interval is silence given a length.
abstract.cn: 间隔就是被量出长度的沉默。

abstract.en: Two notes need the empty air between them to become music.
abstract.cn: 两个音要有中间的空处才成为音乐。

abstract.en: Life is measured in intervals as much as in events.
abstract.cn: 人生不只由事件计量，也由事件之间的间隔计量。

examples.en: The nurse checked his pulse at short intervals.
examples.cn: 护士每隔一小会儿就看一次他的脉搏。

examples.en: There is a wide interval between their two houses.
examples.cn: 他们两家的房子之间隔着很大的距离。

examples.en: During the interval the orchestra stayed on stage.
examples.cn: 幕间休息时乐队留在台上。

dict_mnemonic.text: inter（之间）+ val（墙）——两墙之间空出来的那段

root: 拉丁语 vallum「木桩墙」→ intervallum「两墙之间的空地」→ 古法语 intervalle → 英语 interval。同族有 intervallic、interlude。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: time between events, space between objects, a break in a show, and pitch distance in music.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：事件之间的时间、物体之间的空间、演出中间的休息，以及音乐中的音程。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two posts, and the measured empty ground between them.
core.cn: 核心意象：两根柱子，中间量出的一段空地。

branches.en: THE TICKET: the wait before the next bus.
branches.cn: 车票这条线：下一班车之前的等待。

branches.en: THE FIELD: the distance planted between two trees.
branches.cn: 田地这条线：两棵树之间留出的距离。

branches.en: THE CURTAIN: the pause between two acts.
branches.cn: 幕布这条线：两幕之间的暂停。

branches.en: THE SOUND: the gap that makes two notes a melody.
branches.cn: 声音这条线：让两个音成曲的距离。

branches.en: THE LINK: the same gap, read on a clock or on the ground.
branches.cn: 连接线：同一个空档，或读作时间或读作地面。

intro.en: Interval is inter- "between" plus Latin vallum "rampart", with the noun ending lost in French.
intro.cn: interval 是 inter-「之间」加拉丁语 vallum「壁垒」，名词词尾在法语中磨掉了。

latinIntro.en: Latin vallum and intervallum are recorded; the root also gives English wall.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 vallum 与 intervallum 均有记载，这个词根也给英语带来 wall。

items.example: It marks the space of two sides.
items.exampleCN: 它标出两侧之间的空处。

items.example: The root survives in English wall.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根在英语 wall 中留存。

items.example: The noun named the camp wall.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词指营寨的围墙。

items.example: The noun is the direct source.
French trimmed the Latin ending.
It forms intervallic.

items.meaning: a side of a building or fort
items.example: It keeps the old root alive.
Another inter- word of the same pattern.
items.exampleCN: 同一模式的另一个 inter- 词。

definition_en: the act of becoming involved in a situation from outside, especially to change or stop it
core_image: 会议桌旁原本两方对坐，忽然多出一把椅子放在正中
scene: 两国谈判陷入僵局，第三方派出代表带着折中方案来到桌边。Early medical intervention saved the patient's hand.
sceneCN: 这里 intervention 是「干预、介入」（第 1 个义项：外部力量插手），句意为早期医疗介入保住了病人的手。画面里的物件：折中方案、多出的一把椅子、病历。

pos.zh: 名词：干预；介入；调停

derivatives.zh: 去后缀构成，义为「干预；介入」
加 -ist 构成，义为「干预主义者」
加 -al 构成，义为「介入性的」

senses.title: An act from outside
senses.definition: action taken by a person, group, or state to alter a situation it is not directly part of
senses.definitionCN: 由个人、团体或国家对本不直接属于自己的一方局面采取的、意在改变它的行动
senses.example: The court's intervention ended the strike.
senses.exampleCN: 法院的介入结束了罢工。
senses.why: Latin interventio named the act of coming in between, and the noun keeps it as a thing.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 interventio 指「来到中间」这个动作，名词把它变成一件事。

senses.title: Steps taken to help
senses.definition: professional action taken to improve a person's health, education, or safety
senses.definitionCN: 为改善某人的健康、教育或安全而采取的专业行动
senses.example: Early intervention helps children with hearing problems.
senses.exampleCN: 早期介入对听力有问题的孩子很有帮助。
senses.why: Medicine and teaching softened the word: intervention can be care rather than force.
senses.whyCN: 医学与教育让这个词变软：介入不必是强制，也可以是照护。

senses.title: Stopping a fight
senses.definition: the act of stepping into a conflict in order to separate the parties or end it
senses.definitionCN: 进入冲突以分开双方或结束冲突的行为
senses.example: His intervention stopped the quarrel before anyone was hurt.
senses.exampleCN: 他的介入让争吵在人受伤前就停了。
senses.why: The quarrel picture is the oldest one: someone comes between two raised fists.
senses.whyCN: 劝架的图像最古老：有人走到两只举起的手之间。

intro.en: Intervention is the Latin action noun on intervenire, to come in between.
intro.cn: intervention 是建立在 intervenire（来到中间）上的拉丁语动作名词。

items.en: Venire meant to come; intervenire meant to come between.
items.cn: venire 意为「来」，intervenire 意为「来到中间」。

items.en: Interventio was used for a coming in between two events.
items.cn: interventio 用于指两个事件之间的插入。

items.en: French intervention carried the sense into legal procedure.
items.cn: 法语 intervention 把这个意思带入法律程序。

items.en: English used it for a third party entering a case.
items.cn: 英语用它指第三方进入案件。

items.en: Modern states and clinics made it a term of policy and care.
items.cn: 现代国家与诊所使它成为政策与医疗用语。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the -vent- coming stem; the near-meaning group holds other words for stepping in.
note.cn: 形近组共用 -vent-「来」词干；近义组收其他表示插手的词。

entries.definition: The verb of coming in between.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「干预」。

entries.definition: One who favours stepping in.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「干预主义者」。

entries.definition: Something newly thought up.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「发明」，拼写相近。

entries.definition: Unwanted meddling in another's affairs.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「干涉」，多含贬义。

entries.definition: Helping two sides settle a dispute.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「调解」，重在促成和解。

entries.definition: The state of taking part in something.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「参与」，语气中性。

normalIntro.en: These hooks place the word at the moment an extra chair appears at the table.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把它放在「桌边忽然多出一把椅子」的那一刻。

normal.en: -tion turns intervene into a countable act.
normal.cn: -tion 把 intervene 变成可数的行为。

normal.en: Early intervention is the phrase doctors and teachers share.
normal.cn: early intervention 是医生和老师共用的说法。

normal.en: Government intervention changes markets from outside.
normal.cn: government intervention 从外部改变市场。

normal.en: The word keeps venire, the coming of convene and prevent.
normal.cn: 这个词保留 venire，即 convene 与 prevent 里的「来」。

normal.en: Intervention arrives before anyone has asked for it.
normal.cn: intervention 往往在没人开口请求时就到了。

abstract.en: Intervention is a third hand on a two-hand knot.
abstract.cn: 干预是第三只手去解两个人的结。

abstract.en: To intervene is to decide that waiting is no longer a plan.
abstract.cn: 介入等于判定：再等下去已不算计划。

abstract.en: The kindest intervention can look like an interruption.
abstract.cn: 最善意的介入也可能像一次打断。

examples.en: The report called for intervention by the health ministry.
examples.cn: 报告呼吁卫生部介入。

examples.en: Without prompt intervention the injury would have worsened.
examples.cn: 若不及时介入，伤势会更严重。

examples.en: Their intervention in the market was widely criticised.
examples.cn: 他们对市场的干预受到广泛批评。

dict_mnemonic.text: intervene（走到中间）+ tion（名词）——插到中间这件事

root: 拉丁语 venire「来」→ intervenire「来到中间」→ interventio「介入」→ 古法语 → 英语 intervention。同族有 intervene、convention、prevention。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: outside action, professional help, and stepping into a conflict.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：外部行动、专业救助，以及进入冲突把人拉开。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an extra chair placed at the middle of a table set for two.
core.cn: 核心意象：为两人摆好的桌子正中多出的一把椅子。

branches.en: THE COURT: an outside power changes the outcome.
branches.cn: 法院这条线：外部力量改变结果。

branches.en: THE CLINIC: help offered early and on purpose.
branches.cn: 诊所这条线：越早越好的有意帮助。

branches.en: THE FIST: two fighters pulled apart.
branches.cn: 拳头这条线：两个正要动手的人被拉开。

branches.en: THE LINK: both begin with someone not invited in.
branches.cn: 连接线：两个义项都始于一个未被邀请者到场。

branches.en: THE AIM: helping and stopping share the same goal of less harm.
branches.cn: 目标线：救助与制止都指向更少的伤害。

intro.en: Intervention is inter- plus the root vent- "come" and the noun ending -ion.
intro.cn: intervention 由 inter- 加词根 vent-「来」与名词词尾 -ion 构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin interventio and intervenire are recorded members of this family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 interventio 与 intervenire 都是这一族的记载形式。

items.example: It marks the third position.
The root also appears in event and adventure.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根也见于 event 与 adventure。

items.example: The noun is the direct source.
It makes an abstract noun.
The verb is the base of the noun.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词是名词的基础。

items.example: It forms interventionist.
It forms interventional.
It builds convention from the same root.
items.exampleCN: 它用同一词根构成 convention。

definition_en: a meeting in which someone is asked questions, either to judge them for a job or to get their views for the public
core_image: 两张椅子面对面摆着，中间只有一台录音机
scene: 写字楼的小间里，桌子两侧各坐一人，桌上摊着一份简历和一支笔。The interview lasted barely twenty minutes.
